projects.name: MDOT Five-Year Transportation Program 2027-2031 (Lines)
projects.notes: The service name says 2026_2030 (and misspells 'Progam') but the content is the FY 2027-2031 program. work_type_values listed are WK_SUB_CAT_DESC (9 values, best for filtering: Major Widening, Minor Widening, Reconstruction); WK_TYPE_DESC is finer; WK_CAT_DESC is Bridge/Road/System Operations/Traffic Safety. Only construction phases (PHASE_TYPE_ABBRV='CON'). Future work: ACTL_LET_DATE is null and SCHD_LET_DATE/PHASE_ANTCP_CNST_DATE are in the future; FSCL_YR runs 2023-2031 so some rows are already let. ANTCP_CNST_YRS lists construction years.

projects.name: MDOT Five-Year Transportation Program 2027-2031 (Points)
projects.notes: Point jobs (bridges, spot work) of the same program; same schema as the lines layer.

parcels_statewide_note: No free statewide parcel layer with owner names was found for Michigan.

parcels_counties.notes: City of Detroit open data, not the whole county. Name is the taxpayer of record. Assessed value is about half of market value in Michigan.
Macomb County Tax Parcels. Owner name only, no mailing address. mborsev_0 is the state equalized value (about half of market value); CVT_NAME is the city/township.
Genesee County Land Records and GIS, 2025 parcels. Separate taxpayer fields (TaxName, TaxStreet, TaxCity, TaxState, TaxZip). SEV is about half of market value.

parcels_counties_note: Not found or not reachable in the time allowed: Wayne outside Detroit, Oakland (sold, not free), Kent (server needs a token).
summary: Projects: MDOT Five-Year Transportation Program 2027-2031 lines and points verified, with work type, budget, STIP status and scheduled let dates. Parcels: no statewide owner layer; verified Detroit (Wayne), Macomb and Genesee; Oakland, Kent and the rest of Wayne not available free.
